raw.title: Advanced Health Centre Development O1 at NEOM

details.description:
Deal Structure:
NEOM is offering a unique real estate investment opportunity for investors to develop, finance, own, maintain, and transfer a high priority health asset through a standard Build-Own-Maintain-Transfer (“BOMT”) model with an offtake 

Assets Under Consideration:
- Advanced Health Center (AHC)
            - Type: Advanced Health
            - BUA:  22,933 SQM
            - Construction Start: 2024
            - Operations: 2026/2027
            - Outpatient Clinics: 16
            - Inpatient Beds: 30
- Investor is expected to build in accordance with NEOM’s design and specification requirements and will be able to leverage existing utilities / infrastructure during construction period
- NEOM to cover operational requirements of the assets, inclusive of FFE, operations, and operational maintenance

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• The AHC is a social health asset not envisaged for profit and a critically important enabler to enhance NEOM's livability and ability to attract top global talent
• The AHC will be designed and operated in compliance with the best internationally recognized hospital standards
• The AHC will serve the growing population

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: NEOM’s Health and Well-Being (“HWB”) sector intends to build an integrated health and well-being ecosystem centered entirely on the individual, that goes above and beyond traditional medical care. With world-class treatment and inclusive care, NEOM will harness innovative technology, research and education to become the global benchmark

raw.title: Pumped Hydro Storage (PHS) N1 at NEOM

details.description:
Description of Investment Opportunity
NEOM aims to become the world’s first 100% renewable electricity system with energy generation based mainly on solar. Energy storage is required to store excess solar energy during the day and release it at night. Pumped Hydro Storage (PHS) is the most mature and cost competitive storage available. Waterways and powerhouse to be located completely underground to improve land conservation, durability and aesthetics.

 

Deal Structure:
The project is envisioned to be structured as a Build–Own–Operate–Transfer (“BOOT”) in accordance with best industry practices
Time schedule assumes commercial and financial close in Q3 2025 and first energy in Q4 2029

Technical Considerations: 
- Installed capacity  – 2.2 GW
- Generation max power – 2.1 GW
- Storage capacity – 23.1 GWh
- Time constant in turbine mode – 11 hours
- Round trip efficiency – 80%

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• PHS shall become an iconic piece of energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia
• Robust contractual structure in line with best international practices
• Stable and predictable cash-flows, credit support and risk allocation will ensure bankability of the project

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - NEOM aims to create the world’s first 100% renewable energy system, underpinning demand for long-term energy storage. PHS will be the first of several PHS facilities at NEOM

raw.title: Jeddah Central Development Company Oceanarium

details.description:
Jeddah Central Development Company is seeking a qualified private sector investor interested in partnering to finance the Oceanarium. The company is exploring different private sector participants.

A world-class oceanarium and coral farm, as well as a maritime research hub, situated along the coastal area of Jeddah. Designed by SOM from the United States the facility will feature seven pavilions (Shoreline and Mangrove, Coral Reef, The Vortex, Depth of the Red Sea, Back to the Shore, Restoration & Production of a Reef, and Technology & Products from the Red Sea) aimed at enhancing visitors' experience. The total land area is 43,924 m2, total Gross Floor Area (GFA) is nearly 21,076 m2, with an average capacity of 2,500 persons. 

The Oceanarium is situated at the Jeddah Center destination project, the heart of Jeddah, Saudi Arabia’s second-largest city, and gateway to Mekkah. Spanning an impressive 5.7 million m2, with 9.5 km of coastline. Jeddah Central is set to become a global waterfront destination with extensive mixed-use assets, including hospitality, retail, commercial, and residential properties, and key landmarks. The project is positioned as a leading tourist destination, aiming to preserve Jeddah’s rich culture while revitalizing the downtown area.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Investing in an income-generating asset under a PPP structure.
• Playing a part in financing an environment-friendly—including promoting biodiversity—a social asset with a positive social and environmental impact.
• Diversifying the investment portfolio.
• Fostering trust and collaboration with a leading PIF-owned portfolio company.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: Admission revenue, event space for corporates in coffee and gift shops, superb restaurants, VIP suites, rentals in glass-bottom kayaks, rentals in upcharge experiences (including tours, animal interactions, and sea trek helmet diving), and sponsorships are the seven largest revenue drivers, accounting for over 90% of total revenue.

raw.title: Greywater systems

details.description:
Saudi Jordanian Investment Company unveiled its pioneer project ‘The Kingdom Health’ in 2023, comprising of university with capacity of 600 students and hospital with 330 bed, 72 outpatient clinics and dedicated children’s hospital.

As a part of this project, an opportunity exists to develop and operate a greywater system.

Products covered and application
- Greywater systems in hospitals are used to recycle water from sinks, showers, and laundry for applications like irrigation, toilet flushing, and cooling systems, ensuring efficient water management

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Gain access and penetrate in the new regional markets
• Participate in healthcare project that is aligned with the national and regional goals

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Access to international affiliations with globally renowned institutions - High demand for modern healthcare facilities in Jordan due to rising population and focus on healthcare and medical tourism development

raw.title: Finishing products and façade

details.description:
Saudi Jordanian Investment Company unveiled its pioneer project ‘The Kingdom Health’ in 2023, comprising of university with capacity of 600 students and hospital with 330 bed, 72 outpatient clinics and dedicated children’s hospital.

 As a part of this project, an opportunity exists to manufacture and supply finishing products and façade for the hospital.

Products covered and application

Finishing products – The key finishing products include hygienic coatings, flooring solutions, ceiling systems, wall claddings, doors etc
Façade – The façade required for the hospital with key features such as noise reduction, energy efficiency, fire resistant etc

raw.title: Traction Motor Packing and Winding

details.description:
Establish a facility to localize traction motor packing and winding.

Streamline the production and maintenance of traction motors, reduce lead times, and enhance control over quality assurance.

cardsData.stat:
SAR 150-200M (USD 40-53.3M)
[For plant capacity of ca 400 traction motors/ annum]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Saudi Arabia currently sends ca 400 traction motors annually outside the country for packing and winding
• No local capabilities in the region (mostly Europe-based)
• Demand for packing and winding is expected to grow across the region, resulting in significant service export potential

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia to grow its rail network by 2.5x (to 13,000 km of track) and increase its freight volumes by 8x by 2030, which results in increasing number of traction motors, leading to increase in packing and winding - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g. Etihad rail (UAE), Egypt Rail network)

raw.title: Excavators and Loaders Assembly

details.description:
Establishing one or more excavators and loaders assembly plants to address the local supply gap of 12,800-16,200 units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of excavator and loader units with Stage V diesel engines
- Inclusion of adjacent capabilities in after-sales repair and maintenance services

cardsData.stat:
SAR 350-400M (USD 93.3-106.7M)
[For a facility of 1,500 units per year, excluding land]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Export potential to the Middle Eastern and African market, given absence of assembly facilities in the region
• Advantage over other OEMs owing to customers’ preference for locally produced units for better demand responsiveness
• Opportunity to be an anchor investment in the heavy machinery production sector in one of the most promising and fastest-growing markets in the world

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• Consolidated supply landscape with five global OEMs – Caterpillar (US), Komatsu (Japan), Hyundai-Doosan (South Korea), Volvo (Sweden), and XCMG (China) – holding 75-80% market share
• Each OEM has exclusive local dealerships in Saudi Arabia for sales, distribution, and product support
• Saudi Arabia currently has no assembly facility; the local dealers import fully built-up units
• China, South Korea, India, Japan, and the US account for more than 90% of the imports (by value)

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

raw.title: HVAC chillers

details.description:
Establishing one or more chillers assembly plants  to address the local supply gap of ~15,000 units/annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of air-cooled and water-cooled chillers
- Inclusion of capabilities and equipment to assemble supply chain components (e.g., water cooling towers for water-cooled chillers)
- Inclusion of adjacent capabilities in after-sales repair and maintenance services

cardsData.stat:
SAR 300-350M (USD 80-93.3M)
[For a facility of 4K chillers and 1K water-cooling towers per year; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to replace imports of chillers and water-cooling towers
• Local availability of raw materials and components such as metal plates and heat exchangers
• Advantage over other OEMs owing to customers’ preference for locally produced units for better demand and maintenance responsiveness
• Large facilities will help achieving high EBITDA margins and low payback periods of ~5 years

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• 3 local players supplying less than 10% of the local demand
• Key local players
• Johnson Controls, Zamil AC and Global Cooling Tower Factory
• 5+ local suppliers of chillers components such as heat exchangers: National Condensers Factory, Alessa for Refrigeration and Air Conditioning (non-exhaustive)

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative demand of ~180,000 air-cooled chillers and ~45,000 water-cooled chillers in Saudi Arabia for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, major infrastructure projects (e.g., 2034 World Cup football stadiums) and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

raw.title: Cutting Marble Blocks to Slabs

details.description:
- Establishing of one or more marble cutting factories to address the local supply gap of 7.9-10.2M sqm per annum
- Cutting of marble blocks to slabs for applications in the interiors of residential, hospitality, and commercial real estate developments

cardsData.stat:
SAR 130-170M (USD 34.7-45.3M)
[For a facility of 6M sqm per year; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to fill a gap in local supply chain as currently, no local players involved in cutting marble blocks to slabs
• Opportunity to gain a competitive edge as locally cut slabs of premium marble blocks imported from countries such as Italy and Spain will be more price competitive than slabs imported from the same countries
• Large facility with significant volumes will help achieve attractive EBITDA margins of 18-25% and rapid payback
• Current Market
• Characteristics
• Consolidated market with five local suppliers serving ~85% of the market; only slab cutting, and installation step is localized in Saudi Arabia
• All marble demand is met through imports because Saudi Arabia has limited marble reserves
• Oman, Italy, Egypt, and China account for more than two-thirds of the imports to Saudi Arabia
• All local players currently import marble in the form of slabs

raw.title: Cranes and hoists Production

details.description:
- Establish tower crane / overhead crane / construction hoist component manufacturing + assembly facility to address the local supply gap of ~19,000 cranes and ~70,000 hoists
- Products / Services Targeted: Assembly of cranes / hoists and manufacturing of components

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Locally manufactured units could be cost-competitive vs. imports (up to 15-25% less expensive to produce vs. Europe1) and more tailored to Saudi context (e.g., more resistant to Saudi Arabia weather); partnering required for safety, certification and brand recognition considerations
• Know-how required to manufacture crane elements (i.e., structure, drum and rope guide) available in Saudi Arabia
• Current Market
• Tower/Overhead cranes and hoists are currently 100% imported as SKD and then assembled with locally produced frames

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative national demand ~0.3M cranes and ~1.2M hoists for the 2025-2040 period

raw.title: ETFE Foils Production

details.description:
Establishing one or more ethylene tetrafluoroethylene (ETFE) foils production plants to address the local supply gap of 2-3M sqm per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Polymerization of monomers to form ETFE polymer and subsequent pelletization for easy transport for further processing
- Extrusion of ETFE foils from pelletized ETFE

cardsData.stat:
SAR 60-80M (USD 16-21.3M)
[For a facility of 50K sqm per year; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to become a regional champion in the GCC market, in the absence of any existing player in the region
• Abundant local availability of ethylene, one of the primary monomers of ETFE, at globally cost-competitive prices
• Additional demand from the pharma industry as a biocompatible material for packaging

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• A few global players from US, Europe, and Asia dominate the ETFE polymer granulate and foil extrusion market; there are no players from GCC
• Local suppliers of input material
• Ethylene, one of the primary monomers of ETFE, is available locally from SABIC and Tasnee

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative national demand ~40M sqm of ETFE foils for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to replace imported premium, super-premium, and mid-range sanitary ware products
• Local availability of key raw materials (kaolin, ball clay, feldspar, and silica, as well as gypsum and resin used for making the molds)
• Cost competitiveness of local production due to lower logistics cost and avoidance of 12% import tariffs
• Current Market
• Mid-range and premium segments together make up ~60% of the market
• Local players Saudi Ceramics, Al Forsan, Porsalina, Casa Via cater to basic and a small part of mid-range segment
• Global brands such as Kohler (USA), Roca (Spain), Geberit (Switzerland), RAK Ceramics (UAE) serve mid-range and entire premium segment
• Local suppliers of input materials
• Imerys (kaolin, ball clay), Gulf Sands (silica), Saudi Ceramics (feldspar)

raw.title: Aluminum Profiles Extrusion

details.description:
- Establishing one or more aluminum extrusion lines to address the local supply gap of 100,000 - 140,000  tons per annum
- Extrusion of aluminum billets into profiles for aluminum windows (insulated and non-insulated) to cater to a large proportion of upcoming local demand (~21M units cumulative from 2025 to 2040)

cardsData.stat:
SAR 75-100M (USD 20-26.7M)
[For a facility of 25 ktpa capacity, excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Local availability of aluminum billets through Ma’aden
• Export potential to MENA countries given imports of ~105k tons in 2021 for top five regional importers
• Potential for expansion to adjacent markets (e.g., aerospace and defense, automotive – target to produce 300,000 cars annually in Saudi Arabia by 2030)

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• Market dominated by three large players
• Market supplied through local production and through imports (mainly from Bahrain)
• Key players include Alupco (local), Talco (local), Al Andalous (local) and Balexco (UAE)
• Local suppliers of input materials
• Maaden (aluminum billets)

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Construction demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia - Further demand impetus with growth of downstream industries (e.g., automotive, aerospace and defense)

raw.title: Excavators and Loaders Spares Manufacturing

details.description:
Establishing one or more facilities to manufacture spare components of excavators and loaders (buckets, accessories, cylinders, radiators, hydraulic hoses, track pads, and adjusters) to address the local supply gap of 300,000-390,000 tons per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Focus on catering to the spare parts market for post-warranty units (average post-warranty fleet size is ~48,000 units from 2023 to 2030)
- Future expansion potential to spares of other steel-based components (e.g., book, arm)

cardsData.stat:
SAR 20-25M (USD 5.3-6.7M)
[For a facility of 25,000 - 30,000 tons capacity, excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Growing demand for third-party spares as OEM manufactured spare parts are priced 20-30% higher and often have long lead time of one-to-three months
• Local availability of raw materials (steel)
• Cost advantage over imported spares, which attract a tariff of 10-15%
• Limited manufacturers of components for excavators and loaders in the GCC; proximity to the markets with better pricing and lead times than those of OEMs will enhance competitiveness
• Current Market
• New equipment come with a one-to-two-year warranty during which OEM dealers offer servicing with OEM spare parts
• Post warranty customers are open to using third-party spares, primarily due to cost competitiveness
• Currently, the OEM dealers supply spares to the majority of the market even post warranty due to limited availability of locally manufactured third-party spares

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative demand of ~SAR 38B for spares of buckets, accessories, cylinders, radiators, hydraulic hoses, track pads, and adjusters in Saudi Arabia for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

raw.title: Exterior Insulation and Finish Systems (EIFS) production

details.description:
Establishing one or more EIFS production plants to address the local supply gap of 4-6M sqm per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Production of key elements of EIFS such as insulation boards and reinforcement mesh
- Installation of the system on-site, including attaching insulation boards, applying base coat, embedding reinforcement mesh, and applying finish coat
- Inclusion of capabilities to fabricate EIFS in off-site factories

cardsData.stat:
SAR 30-45M (USD 8-12M)
[For a facility of 200K sqm per year; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to capture a rapidly growing market due to the increased regulatory push for higher energy efficiency in construction
• Abundant local availability of key raw materials such as acrylic, polystyrene, resins, and glass fiber
• Opportunity to export to the wider GCC region, given limited regional manufacturers, and high dependence on imports

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• Market supplied primarily by global players from Europe, Asia, and Americas; Terraco (UAE) is the only major player in GCC
• Industrial Polystone Factory is the only local player; with capacity of less than 1% of the expected demand
• Local suppliers of input material
• Tasnee (acrylic), Sappco (polystyrene), Saudi Industrial Resins Limited (resins), Glass Fiber Technology Co. (fiberglass)

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative national demand of ~81M sqm of EIFS for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

details.description:
OPDC's THE RIG. project offers an opportunity for the private sector to propose innovative and sustainable mass mobility solutions for transporting visitors from onshore terminals to THE RIG. destination. This project spans 30 years, with the possibility of the operating model being based on a long-term lease or an operational management model.

The focus is on offering safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly transportation solutions, including options such as electric, hybrid, and cutting-edge technologies like sea gliders or hovercraft.

Products/services covered
The primary services targeted by this opportunity are transportation and mobility solutions for visitors. The focus is on providing a mass transit system that ensures safe, efficient, and comfortable transportation between onshore terminals and offshore on THE RIG. destination. The products or services could include
 - Electric or hybrid-powered transport options.
- Innovative transportation technologies (e.g., sea gliders, hovercraft).
- Long-term operational leasing or management services.
- Maintenance and safety assurance services for transportation solutions.
 
Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Design and Development
- The development and design of transportation solutions (e.g., electric/hybrid vehicles, sea gliders, hovercraft).

Manufacturing
- The production of transportation solutions, including any customization needed for offshore travel.

Operations
- Managing the transportation of visitors on a daily basis, including crew operations, maintenance, and safety management.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Tourism Development
• The project enhances the tourism sector, contributing to KSA’s ambition to become a leading global tourist destination. THE RIG project will likely attract significant numbers of international visitors, making efficient mass mobility solutions essential.
• Technological Leadership
• The opportunity allows for the integration of cutting-edge mobility technologies such as sea gliders and hovercraft, reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s position as a leader in innovative and advanced transport systems.
• Long-Term Revenue Generation
• With a 30-year span and the potential for long-term leases or operation models, the project offers significant financial returns, making it an attractive investment for the private sector.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Tourism Sector Growth: Projected YoY growth of 7-8% through 2030. - The GCC region is expected to see a YoY growth of 5-7% in tourism.  Government Initiatives and Investments  Technological Innovations in Mobility - Innovations like electric, hybrid, and autonomous transportation systems.

raw.title: Accommodation Facilities at the RIG

details.description:
Oil Park Development Company (OPDC) is seeking private sector participation to develop or provide accommodation for 2,300 employees working in the tourism and hotel sector at THE RIG.

This opportunity invites private investors to either construct new accommodation facilities tailored to the project’s needs, or propose existing assets that can be repurposed or adapted for this purpose.

Products/services covered
- Long-term workforce accommodation solutions (housing, utilities, and amenities).
- Hospitality services, including catering and housekeeping for employees.

Secondary Services
- Facility management (maintenance, operations, and security) and transportation services to and from THE RIG. site.

Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Upstream
- Design and development of accommodation facilities (construction or retrofitting existing buildings).
- Securing private investment or joint venture partnerships with OPDC.

Midstream
- Construction or adaptation of assets to meet OPDC’s specifications for employee accommodation.
- Development of infrastructure to provide utilities, transportation, and connectivity.

Downstream
- Day-to-day operation and management of the accommodation facilities.
- Providing services such as catering, cleaning, maintenance, and security.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The hospitality and tourism workforce in Saudi Arabia is growing at a rate of 7-10% YoY. - The broader GCC hospitality market is growing at 4-6% YoY. - The hospitality sector in Saudi Arabia is expected to boom due to giga-projects and government support of tourism.

raw.title: Retrofitting conventional port cranes

details.description:
Retrofitting conventional cranes involves upgrading existing crane systems with new technologies.

The process may include:
- Electrification: Installing electric power systems to replace diesel engines
- Automation: Integrating automation and remote monitoring systems for improved operation and implementing advanced safety features

cardsData.stat:
SAR 7-10M (USD 1.9-2.7M)
[OpEx requirement per annum to deploy a retrofitting team includes electrical and mechanical engineers, welders and fabricators, technicians, and other supporting functions]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point: • There are currently no local players in the Saudi market.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Transition to smart ports across ports in Saudi Arabia. - Electrification targets being set by the Saudi Ports Authority for all ports.

raw.title: Fluoride

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to build on Ma’aden’s high level of imports and establish a manufacturing plant for aluminum fluoride in Saudi Arabia.

- Application: Fluoride is a highly reactive and corrosive chemical element that is used in the mining industry for various purposes. This is primarily used in the production of aluminum.

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals (Fluoride).

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Aluminum smelting capacity expected to increase in short-medium term, creating further demand.
• Demand for aluminum fluoride mainly dependent on production of aluminum metal and therefore driven by increase in downstream production of aluminum.
• Easy access to local customer base (Ma’aden has significant demand for aluminum fluoride and is currently fully dependent on imports).

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - In 2018, Saudi Arabia imported 9KT of aluminum fluoride, representing 100% of its local demand.

raw.title: Construction and Demolition Waste Recycling Facility Joint Venture

details.description:
SIRC subsidiary AKAM seeks a joint venture partner to establish, operate, and manage a state-of-the-art Construction and Demolition Waste (CDW) recycling facility in Saudi Arabia. This joint venture (JV) aims to transform CDW into valuable products, driving environmental sustainability and contributing to economic diversification.

Targeted Products
The recycling facility will focus on producing:
- Recycled aggregates.
- Sand.
- Other marketable materials derived from CDW.
 
Value Chain Activities
The JV will cover:
- Facility design and engineering.
- Construction and commissioning.
- Processing and recycling operations.
- Quality assurance and compliance.
- Sales and distribution of recycled products.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Supporting Saudi Vision 2030 goals of environmental sustainability and economic diversification.
• Enhancing landfill diversion rates and improving the recycling landscape.
• Contributing to the circular economy by transforming CDW into valuable products

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The growth rate in Saudi Arabia for CDW recycling is projected to be approximately 4% YoY until 2030. - Increasing construction and demolition activity in Saudi Arabia driven by large-scale giga- and mega-projects undertaken in line with Vision 2030. - The demand is also driven by government regulations promoting recycling. - Growing awareness and demand for sustainable building materials. - Adoption of environmental certifications like LEED and WELL.

raw.title: Providing Electricity to THE RIG

details.description:
OPDC is seeking private sector investment to develop and supply electricity for THE RIG. project, a flagship tourism destination in Saudi Arabia. The opportunity involves designing, financing, building, operating, and transferring (BOT) a power generation and/or distribution system to meet the high-energy demands of the project. The BOT model ensures a long-term partnership with private investors for a contract period of 30 years or more.

Products/services covered

Primary Service
- Reliable electricity generation and distribution tailored to the needs of THE RIG.

Target Solutions
Renewable energy options, hybrid power systems, or conventional energy generation solutions. Secondary Services: Maintenance, operation, and management of the power infrastructure for the duration of the BOT contract.

 Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Upstream
- Investment and financing by private sector players.

Midstream
- Development, installation, and commissioning of power generation and distribution infrastructure.

Downstream
- Ongoing operation, maintenance, and delivery of electricity to meet THE RIG.'s energy requirements.

Focus Area
The opportunity is primarily concentrated on establishing a sustainable and efficient energy supply chain that ensures operational reliability for THE RIG. while leveraging private sector expertise and capital.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia's electricity demand has been growing at an annual rate of 3-5% YoY. - The GCC’s electricity market is expected to grow by 2-4% YoY.

raw.title: Aluminum Scrap

details.description:
- Description An opportunity exists to develop local capabilities for recycling Aluminum scrap.

- Application: Aluminum  scrap is recyclable materials from post manufacturing processes or consumption. Applications include reuse in aluminum  production. The process involves simply re-melting the metal, which is far less expensive and energy intensive than producing new aluminum  from Bauxite Ore.

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals - aluminum  7602 Scrap – Mixed, Ext, Coated (UBC), 1st Quality.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Globally, aluminum is one of the most profitable materials to recycle and has achieved higher recycling rates due to government’s focus on energy saving, reducing wastage.
• Quality: Concerns around the quality of aluminum scrap – Ma’aden requires aluminum 7602 Scrap – Mixed, Ext, Coated (UBC), 1st Quality.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The global aluminum scrap recycling market size is estimated to grow at a significant CAGR of 8.9% during the forecast period 2022-2027. - 52 % (625 KMT) of total scrap generated in GCC countries is exported without being processed. - Diverse supply market, as aluminum scrap can come from a multitude of sources.

raw.title: Petroleum Coke

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to establish local manufacturing facility with a capacity of 250 ktpa for petroleum coke.

- Application: Petroleum coke is a carbon-rich solid material that is produced during oil refining. In its raw form it is known as Green Petroleum Coke (GPC). It is used for carbon anode manufacturing in aluminum smelters

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals (Petroleum Coke).

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Calcined Petroleum Coke (CPC) offers good potential with favorable logistics to export to rest of the leading MENA aluminum smelters and steel plants – very large amount of foreign spend to be localized.
• Saudi Arabia has proximity to raw material (Green Petroleum Coke) sources, including UAE and Oman – increasing investment opportunity.
• Ma’aden have agreed a major deal signed from 2025 onwards to purchase Pet Coke locally from new facility in Saudi Arabia. Despite this agreement, there is still significant opportunity to build on local capability within Saudi Arabia.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - First mover advantages due to lack of established capacity in Saudi Arabia. - Ma’aden Aluminum would be the primary buyer within Saudi Arabia. - Saudi Arabia’s geographical advantage and trade agreements with neighboring countries make exporting favorable.

raw.title: Alloys

details.description:
- Description: Significant opportunity exists to establish local capacity of 7500 (MTPA) minimum. 

Saudi Arabia can leverage its strategic location and strong logistics infrastructure to enhance export capability.

- Saudi Arabia has an opportunity for first mover advantage due to non-existent local production of alloys and alloy-based parts

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals (Alloys)

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Saudi Arabia has the world’s largest integrated Aluminum city at Ras Al-Khair which provides easy & uninterrupted access of feedstock.
• Saudi Arabia is strategically located at the crossroads of several markets that have good demand potential.
• Saudi Arabia benefits from having abundant and easy access to utilities, raw materials and a world class infrastructure with good access to port.
• Progressive value chain integration will position Aluminum master alloys as an attractive niche product offering value addition potential locally, with high export opportunities and higher netback realization.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Titanium alloys: Global Titanium Alloy Market Was Valued at US$4.3B in 2021 and is Projected to Reach US$8.4B by the End of 2029, Exhibiting a healthy CAGR of 6.5% Between 2022 and 2029. - Manganese-based alloys: Global growth at a rate of 4.7% in the forecast period 2022 to 2029.

raw.title: Smart water meters

details.description:
- Specifications:
1. Setting up a smart water meters manufacturing plant.
2. Setting up a smart water meter component manufacturing plant to cater to water sector requirements across the local and regional markets.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point: • High potential of localization of meter manufacturing as local sourcing of key component and material is available in KSA.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia water meter expected to grow by ~8% CAGR until 2030 primarily driven by shift towards smart water meter. - Increased rate of home ownership (70% targeted by 2030) would spur demand for water meter connections. - Additional 1.9 m connections of water and wastewater connections driving the need for smart water meters. - Replacement of conventional meters with smart water meter. - Projects such as NEOM, the Red Sea Project, Qiddiya Entertainment City, King Abdullah Financial District and Amaala to create significant demand. - Further growth can be expected if NWC decides to install water meter in every households ( Currently in many cases water meter are installed at a building level).

raw.title: Post-Processing Services for Manufacturing

details.description:
National Additive Manufacturing & Innovation Company (NAMI), a joint venture between 3D Systems Corporation and Dussur, specializes in first of its kind innovation and 3D printing center.

The opportunity lies in providing a range of post-processing services to enhance the quality, functionality, and performance of manufactured products in Saudi Arabia.

Products/Services covered

Surface finishing
- Sanding, polishing, sand blasting, shot peening, chemical milling, tumbling, electropolishing, abrasive flow machining, painting

Heat treatment
- Stress relief, aging, solution annealing (vacuum HT) for Steels, Ni-alloys, Titanium, Al-alloys

Cleaning
- Ultrasonic cleaning, chemical cleaning, advanced de-powdering

Inspection and quality control
- Dimensional inspection (CMM, optical), non-destructive testing (X-Ray, FPI, DPI), powder flowability & PSD

Assembly and integration
- Final assembly of components, coatings

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Improved product quality and performance
• Reduced manufacturing costs in comparison with outsourcing abroad
• Supporting local manufacturing growth
• Opening new markets for customer looking only for finished components

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi growth rate is projected at 22.4% YoY, supported by additive manufacturing growth - Growth rate estimated at 11.4% YoY in the GCC sector - The expansion of various industries, such as defense, aerospace, automotive, healthcare, and oil & gas, energy are driving the demand for advanced manufacturing techniques where additive manufacturing is key contributor

raw.title: Magnesium

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to invest in expanding the local supply of Magnesium by establishing plant with a capacity of 30 ktpa.

- Magnesium is mainly used in aluminum  alloys (34% of global demand), magnesium die-castings (32% of global demand) and titanium sponge production (15% of demand). Other end-uses include steel desulphurization, iron casting and cathodic protection.

- Application: Magnesium is a lightweight, silvery-white metal that is commonly used in the mining industry. Magnesium oxide (MgO) is produced by the calcination of magnesium carbonate.

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals (Magnesium).

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Increasing demand is driven by the growth of the automotive industry and their need for magnesium die casting.
• Saudi Arabia and global market is projected to continue to grow until the year 2030 and beyond (extreme CAGR of 10.8%).

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia has abundant dolomite resources which could be used as feedstock for the magnesium metal plant.

raw.title: Sodium Cyanide

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to develop local capabilities for sodium cyanide.

- Potential to collaborate with local industries and waste management facilities to utilize byproducts, creating a circular economy model that minimizes waste and maximizes resource utilization.

- Application: Sodium cyanide, a chemical compound renowned for its role in the mining sector, is indispensable for gold extraction processes. Its ability to form stable complexes with gold allows for efficient separation from ore, enabling extraction methods like cyanidation. 

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals - Sodium Cyanide (Assay solid with 98% purity in cubic form).

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Increases in mining activity would create increased demand for sodium cyanide.
• Resource synergy – Saudi Arabia has abundant petrochemical resources, helping to create a secure and local supply chain for key raw materials required for sodium cyanide production, creating cost-efficiencies and reliability
• Proportional increases in demand with expansion of the mining industry / sector.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - MENA is the biggest importer of Sodium Cyanide. Asia is the biggest exporter. - Ma’aden procures only one type of Sodium Cyanide (Assay solid with 98% purity in cubic form). - Potential to collaborate with Ma’aden, providing essential sodium cyanide for gold extraction.

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to establish local manufacturing plant with a capacity of 70 ktpa for the refractory materials to capitalize on the increasing upcoming demand in Saudi Arabia.

- Products / Services Targeted: Equipment MRO Refractory (Bricks, Castables, Monolithics).

strategicBenefitsPoints.point: • Demand for the refractory materials will be mainly driven by recovery in the construction, infrastructure industrial, and mining sectors.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Refractory Saudi demand in 2020 was 160-170 ktpa, growing at 6-7% CAGR until 2027. - Significant growth expected in the global market as well as in Saudi Arabia in the years to come. - Similar growth observed in neighboring countries, thus opening the filtration market beyond Saudi Arabia.

raw.title: Bearings, Bushings and Wheels

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists in building strength in local capability and capacity for bearings, also for bushings, wheels, and related-parts.

- Application: Vital in mining, bearings, bushings, and wheels are mechanical essentials, enabling diverse functions by facilitating smooth movement, reducing friction, and supporting heavy loads. 

- Products / Services Targeted: Equipment MRO (Roller Bearings, Ball Bearings, Drill Jig Bushings, Steel Shoulder, Bushings).

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• The global market size for bearings is estimated at USD 48B for 2021, increasing to USD 56B by 2026 (CAGR of 3.4% during period).
• In Saudi Arabia, local demand is supplied via imports, while global firms import and distribute in Saudi Arabia. This prompts a chance for local production to replace imports.
• Saudi Arabia demand for Bearings, Bushings, & Wheels is met through imports with 84% of this demand originating from high-cost countries

raw.title: Data center power equipment

details.description:
- Description: Provide power equipment to the 1,100 MW anticipated data center capacity that ensures consistent, reliable and uninterrupted power supply.

- Service: Assembly, installation, and after sales services of data center power equipment in Saudi Arabia including but not limited to uninterruptible power supply (UPS), back up generators, power distribution units (PDU), electrical switchgear, automatic transfer switch (ATS), and static transfer switch (STS).

- Customers: Potential key clients include PIF Portfolio Companies, global data center services players attracted to Saudi Arabia, hyperscalers, tech players entering/ increasing share in data center sector (e.g., Huawei).

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Skyrocketing data storage needs from personal data protection law and cloud computing Regulatory Framework.
• Growing need for data center supply from government bodies and corporates driven by digitalization trend and smart government initiatives.

raw.title: Aluminum Extrusion

details.description:
- Manufacturing of Aluminum extrusion products for applications in vehicles especially catering to the demand from Saudi Arabia-based OEMs.
- Product mainly include aluminum extrusion structures for EVs  e.g., roof rails, door frames, dashboard frame and supports, profiles for battery frame.
- Manufacturing of aluminum extrusion components can be supplied to tier-1 suppliers or directly to OEMs. This opportunity occurs in tier-2 and tier-1 manufacturing phases, prior to the assembly/distribution.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Leverage availability of raw material in Saudi Arabia.
• Cater to localization requirements of OEM projects, while fostering high-precision aluminum extrusion capabilities in Saudi Arabia.
• Expand aluminum extrusion capability into other applications (e.g., construction industry).

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Localization of OEMs production in Saudi Arabia, with confirmed projects by Lucid, Ceer – expected production of >300,000 vehicles a year. - Aluminum is considered a favored material for EVs, as it offers value to OEMs in terms of manufacturing costs, weight savings & performance. - Average aluminum content in a light vehicle is expected to increase to 222 kg/ vehicle by 2030. - 17% CAGR estimated for Saudi Arabia demand (mainly from automotive applications).

raw.title: Carpet and Acoustics including Noise, Vibration, and Harshness (NVH)

details.description:
- Manufacturing of carpets and acoustic systems for light vehicle applications, to be used for car interior/ hood/ underbody/ trunk.
- Acoustic/ insulation systems for OEM/ Tier-1 requirements e.g., car headliner, trunk, door trim, e-motor, battery, wheel encapsulation, instrument panel, center console.
- This opportunity occurs in tier-1 and tier-2 manufacturing phases, prior to the assembly/distribution with potential production opportunity for aftersales market.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Cater to localization requirements of OEM projects.
• Leverage low raw material (plastic, fibers) prices in Saudi Arabia.
• Potentially expand into other vehicle segments and consumer goods.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Localization of OEMs production in Saudi Arabia, with confirmed projects by Lucid, Ceer – expected production of >300,000 vehicles a year. - Rising demand for vehicle carpet customization (color, texture, and design). - Increasing use of high-quality, scratch-resistant material for floor carpets. - Increasing demand for enhanced comfort and safety features (e.g., material that allows noise levels to remain within permissible limits).

raw.title: Pumps and Compressors

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to establish a new local pumps and compressors facility to supply multiple Saudi markets and industries.

- Application: Pumps are a vital mechanical tools utilized in the mining industry that propel liquids or gases through mechanical means. They play a crucial role in tasks such as fluid transport & enhancing operational efficiency.

- Products/Services Targeted: Equipment MRO (Pumps).

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Gain new market share in a continuously evolving and expanding market.
• Steady demand from multiple domestic industries that require annual repair & replacement of the pumps.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The global market is growing at 5% per annum (2021 to 2030), and Saudi Arabia market size demand is growing by 3-5% annually (2018 to 2024). - Local manufacturers supply to 50% of the local demand, with a utilization rate of 85%.

raw.title: Pipes, Hoses and Connections

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to establish local manufacturing facility and develop capabilities for pipes, hoses and connections.

- Application: Pipes and connections are vital in mining, enabling the transport of minerals and maintaining breathable air through ventilation systems, ensuring efficient and safe operations in demanding conditions.

- Products / Services Targeted: Equipment MRO (Pipes, hoses and connections).

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Saudi Arabia is currently developing sustainably semi-finished & finished metal industries (downstream).
• Currently, Saudi Arabia's demand for pipe fittings is addressed almost fully through imports (94% of total demand), presenting a great opportunity to localize production.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Growing mining industry, pipes would directly support the SAR 4.8 Tn of untapped mining potential. - The Saudi demand for pipe fittings is expected to make up ~40% of the overall GCC demand. - First mover advantage given limited presence of local production facility.

raw.title: Terminal Operating System (ToS) associated services

details.description:
Localize ToS associated services.

ToS associated services may include:
- Database administration services which involve the management, maintenance, and optimization of databases by a team of experts.
- ToS support services which include technical support for ToS systems and software updates.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Associated services are outsourced to global players today.
• Potential to expand these services to GCC port operators, since ToS systems deployed in the region are similar to the ones in Saudi Arabia (e.g., Abu Dhabi ports – Master Terminal ToS; Mwani – Navis N4 ToS).

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia to increase port throughput from 9M TEU to 40M TEU by 2030, which results in increased need for ToS associated services to improve efficiency, resulting in higher spend on these services. - Future digitization efforts (i.e., smart ports) are expected to drive data traffic volume growth by ca 26% per annum. - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g., Kuwait port expansion).

details.description:
Deal Structure:
The Project presents an investment opportunity for the private sector to enter into a development agreement to design, build, finance, operate, insure, and maintain a Construction and Staff Village The transaction will be structured as a 32-year deal, with an upfront investment of ~SAR 2-3B required from the private sector for construction

Assets Under Consideration:
- The project will involve development of a ~12,300-bed Construction Village to meet the short-term demand for 2 years in 2024-2026
- The development will then be converted, over a 3-month rolling refurbishment period, to a permanent ~8,500-bed Staff Village to meet the long-term staff accommodation demand for 30 years
- The project will accommodate a portion of the staff expected to be employed

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Captive and exclusive tenant market: hotels / hospitality businesses will use these staff villages on an exclusive basis, therefore de-risking the investment
• Consistent cash flow generation during the construction phase: the construction village will be used by captive contractors’ staff ensuring high utilization and cash flow generation
• NEOM commitment: significant developments are already underway
• Capital efficient investment: opportunity to invest into a unique product with low refurbishment costs to convert into Staff Village, and generating long term cashflows

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Access to NEOM : Opportunity to become a key development and investment partner in developing NEOM, and access subsequent investment opportunities across NEOM - Promising tourism demand: Demand for hotel assets is expected to be very high, as NEOM is planned to be a key tourist attractor for the wider region with its unique offerings and year-round activities

raw.title: Tires for heavy equipment

details.description:
Description of Investment Opportunity
Establish local manufacturing/ retreading facility specializing in industrial tires for trucks and mobile cranes (e.g., rubber-tired gantry cranes).

Manufacture tires for heavy equipment used in numerous sectors (e.g., maritime sector for container handlers, construction industry for loaders, mining sector for haul trucks), including:
- Tube tires
- Tubeless tires
- Retreading

cardsData.stat:
SAR 300-400M (USD 80-106.7M)
[For plant capacity of 3 – 4 M unit/annum]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• There are currently no local players in manufacturing tires for heavy equipment
• High expected demand for retreaded tires for heavy equipment, given financial upside to end-user (retreaded tires can endure 75 – 80% of the lifetime of new tires, provided they are well maintained)
• Export potential3 of SAR 400 – 500M annually

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia to increase port throughput from 9M TEU to 40M TEU by 2030 (~20% CAGR), implying increased need for industrial tires, and therefore increased spend on this category - SGP and RSGT plan to increase their cargo-handling capacity by ~2.5x until 2030 - Demand driven by Saudi Vision 2030 projects (e.g., infrastructure related giga-projects)

raw.title: Laboratory Services

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to source appropriately skilled manpower to serve local Saudi market with a prioritization of Saudi nationals across all sectors and industries in line with Saudization objectives.

- Application: Laboratory services in the mining industry refer to the testing, analysis, and certification of minerals, ores, and other materials used in mining operations.

- Products / Services Targeted: Analytical testing, environmental testing, mineral processing testing, including sample testing, fire assay testing, radioactivity testing.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Strong market growth in the next 5 years.
• Growing mining industry as the third pillar of the Saudi economy – with growth in mining comes growth in demand for associated laboratory services.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The global geochemical services (which encompasses services related to mining) market size was SAR 3.8B in 2021. - The market is projected to grow from SAR 3.8B in 2021 to SAR 5.3B in 2028, equivalent to a CAGR of 4.9% during the 2021 to 2028 period.

raw.title: Freight wagons

details.description:
- Establishment of a manufacturing facility for freight wagons.

raw.title: Local Unit Exchange (UTEX) for Replacement Parts

details.description:
Establish a local UTEX providing a comprehensive inventory of spare parts, increasing availability.

A UTEX allows a defective part in the rail sector to be replaced in a few days, while it gets repaired to new condition and goes into UTEX inventory.

cardsData.stat:
SAR 1-1.2B (USD 0.27-0.32B)
Projected for 2024-2030 across Saudi Arabia

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Saudi-based UTEX will be well-positioned to cater to the broader GCC rolling stock spares market.
• Export potential of SAR 100 – 150 M annually.
• Opportunity to replace imports of new spare parts to Saudi Arabia.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia to grow its rail network by 2.5x (to 13,000 km of track), increase passenger volume by 10x, and increase freight volumes by 8x by 2030, which results in increasing use for spare parts, and therefore increasing maintenance, repairs and operations spend. - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g., Etihad rail (UAE), Egypt Rail network).

raw.title: Pitch

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to invest in capability within Saudi Arabia to counter the strong foreign supply to Saudi Arabia.

- Application: Pitch is used in electrode production in the aluminum  industry.

- Products / Services Targeted: Liquid pitch manufacturing facility.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Resource availability – abundant access to petroleum resources, a primary source for producing liquid pitch. Leveraging local resources ensures a stable supply chain and has cost advantages.
• Potential to position liquid pitch manufacturing facility strategically to supply neighboring countries in the Gulf region. Saudi Arabia's geographical proximity and connectivity enhances export potential.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Global liquid pitch market estimated at SAR 13.1B in 2020, expected to reach SAR 19.1B by 2027 registering a CAGR of 5.4%. - Demand for pitch is driven by end use industries such as aluminum and Steel, both of which are growing in Saudi Arabia.

raw.title: Railway Steel Wheels and Axles Manufacturing

details.description:
- Establishment of a manufacturing facility to produce running gear spare parts, i.e., wheelsets and axles.
- Wheels should be built through forging process, with an average wheel life of 200,000 km in KSA climate conditions.

cardsData.stat:
SAR 70-100M (USD 18.7-26.7M)
[For plant capacity of ~25k wheelsets annually]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Only 1% of SAR’s spare part stock value is KSA-made.
• Steel wheels account for 30-50% of annual running gear OPEX spend at SAR.
• Export potential of SAR 100 – 150 M annually.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia to grow its rail network by ~2.5x (to 13,000 km of track), which will result in additional need for running gear spare parts, implying increasing spend on wheelsets . - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g., Etihad rail (UAE), Egypt Rail network).

raw.title: Gaskets and Seals

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to meet Ma’aden’s demand through domestically manufactured products, Establish local manufacturing capability for Caskets & Steals.

- A gasket fills the space between two or more mating surfaces to prevent leakage from the joined objects while under compression. Category scope includes gaskets, bushing and their sub types.

- Ma’aden’s existing gasket demand is currently split between in country and foreign suppliers, opportunity exists to more fully meet Ma’aden’s demand through domestically manufactured products.
- Value chain: Gaskets can mainly be found Inside process equipment like pumps and compressors or outside process equipment like flanges.

- Application: Gaskets are mechanical components used in the mining industry to seal joints and prevent leaks. Seals are mechanical components used in the mining industry to prevent the leakage of fluids, gases, and other substances.  

- Products / Services Targeted: Gaskets, spiral wound, pre-cut, jacketed, ring joint, camprofile. seals, mechanical, Labyrinth.

raw.title: Spare Parts for Cargo-Handling Equipment

details.description:
Establish a manufacturing facility for spare parts for cargo handling equipment, with the potential to expand into components for other heavy vehicles such as trucks and prime movers.
Manufacture components such as:
- Engine components (e.g., alternators) (replacement rate of 10,000 – 15,000 hours of operations).
- Invertors (replacement rate of 18,000 – 20,000 hours of operations).
- Electrical components (e.g., capacitor, circuit breakers) (replacement rate of 18,000 – 20,000 hours of operations).
- Mechanical components (e.g., steering columns, pumps, pulleys) (replacement rate of 8,000 – 12,000 hours of operations).
- Hydraulic systems (e.g., hydraulic pumps, hydraulic tanks) (replacement rate of 5,000 – 10,000 hours of operations).

raw.title: Optical Transceivers

details.description:
- Localize assembly of optical transceivers (OTs), which are devices that combine both the transmitter and receiver functions into a single module, allowing bidirectional communication in optical networks.

- Product: Optical transceivers convert the electrical signal from a switch or router to an optical signal that can be transmitted and received over a fiber optic.

- Customers: Potential key clients include telecoms operators and data center players (for data center networking).

raw.title: Grinding Media

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to address current market and take advantage of growing demand to establish strong local manufacturing capability.

- Market can be segmented by type into forged grinding media, high chrome cast grinding media, others, and can be segmented by application into chemistry industry, metallurgy industry, cement plant, power plant, others.

- Application: Grinding media are objects used to grind material into smaller particles and can be divided into two categories: natural and artificial. 

- Products / Services Targeted: Natural and artificial grinding media.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point: • Global grinding media market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 5.5% during the forecast period from 2018 to 2030. It was valued at SAR 28.5B in 2023 and is likely to reach SAR 44.3B by 2032.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Strategic location – Saudi Arabia is a key gateway to MENA, access to large consumer base. - First mover advantage given limited presence of local production facility. - No major existing players to address the local market, showing scale of opportunity.

Assembly of a wide range of cargo-handling equipment including:
- Quay cranes
- Rubber tire gantry (RTGs)

cardsData.stat:
SAR 400-500M (USD 106.7-133.3M)

• Currently there are no local assembly capabilities of quay cranes or RTGs; potential to replace Saudi imports of SAR 60 – 70 M per annum

raw.title: Rail bars

details.description:
- Localize manufacturing of rail bars, including welds and joints.
- Manufacturing rail bars entails establishing domestic production facilities equipped with advanced processes like steel rolling, welding and heat treatment.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Currently no local rail-steel grade manufacturing capabilities – SAR 500M, 260 kt imports in 2018 (peak imports over past five years).
• Recurring rail bar demand due to replacements during maintenance.
• Export potential of SAR 120 – 160 M annually.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia to grow its rail network by ~2.5x (to 13,000 km of track), resulting in additional rail bars in Kingdom, increasing spend on this category. - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g., Etihad rail (UAE), Egypt Rail network).

raw.title: High-Volume MRO Materials for Rail Operations

details.description:
Set up a manufacturing plant for maintenance supplies and consumables.

Manufacture a wide range of maintenance supplies, to be used in numerous sectors, including the rail sector (infrastructure materials, such as nuts, washers, bolts and screws).

cardsData.stat:
SAR 100-150M (USD 26.7-40M)
[For plant capacity of ~800 M units/annum]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Absence of local suppliers for high-volume MRO materials
• Targeted components have standardized specifications with cross-industrial applications (i.e., maritime, aviation)
• Export potential of SAR 3 – 4 M annually
• Potential to become supplier of choice for Saudi rail operators, given current global supplier lead-time is eight months (e.g., CRRC, WABTEC)

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia to grow its rail network by 2.5x (to 13,000 km of track), increase passenger volume by 10x, and increase freight volumes by 8x by 2030, leading to an increase in the usage of maintenance supplies, and therefore increasing the spend on these materials - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g., Etihad rail (UAE), Egypt Rail network)

raw.title: Filtration Components and Machinery

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to address current market and take advantage of growing demand to establish strong local manufacturing capability.

- Application: In the mining sector, filtration components and machinery are paramount for maintaining product quality and safeguarding equipment against detrimental contaminants. By effectively removing impurities and particulates, these systems contribute to smoother operations.

- Products / Services Targeted: Equipment MRO (Filtration components and machinery).

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Growing need for treated water and for desalinated water to supply surging demand – Saudi Arabia filtration market expected to grow to SAR 375M
• Local manufacturing of filtration equipment in Saudi Arabia around 40% of the total supply volume in the market – presence of assembly activities in Saudi Arabia.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Potential for 100% private investment with an opportunity for organic growth or partnerships. - Similar growth observed in neighboring countries, thus opening the filtration market beyond Saudi Arabia.

raw.title: Valves and Blocks

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to develop strong local capability in this area, providing valves and blocks supply for many sectors.

- Application: Valves and blocks are vital for fluid and gas control in piping systems. In mining, valves regulate flow and pressure, aiding substance management, while blocks strategically redirect fluid paths, enhancing system performance and integrity.

- Products / Services Targeted: Equipment MRO (Valves & Blocks).

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Giga-projects planned/initiated in Saudi Arabia to drive demand for valves in both industrial and commercial segments over next 10 – 15 years.
• Sector opportunities include catering demand by company as well as contractors in the region.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The Saudi market size (2021) is SAR 5.4B growing by 7% annually to become SAR 10.3B by 2030. - Easy access to high growth industrial valves market – GCC projected to grow at 3.1% p.a.

raw.title: Aircraft disassembly, dismantling and recycling

details.description:
The aviation industry is undergoing a significant transformation, with airlines modernizing their fleets and retiring older aircraft at an accelerating pace.

This has created an opportunity to establish a state-of-the-art aircraft recycling hub dedicated to the aerospace industry with a melting capability to produce raw material and a recycled spare parts facility.

The facility would serve not only local but also regional airlines.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• There is a growing trend towards retiring older aircrafts due to up to 40% higher fuel consumption
• The opportunity also aligns with Saudi Green Initiative by promoting sustainable industrial practices, reducing waste, and cutting carbon emissions.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: The airline operators in the region are estimated to experience a demand for around 2,900 new aircraft over the next 20 years, increasing the retirement of older aircrafts The Middle East market is growing at CAGR of 3.3% and is expected to be SAR 800-850M by 2030

raw.title: Valves

details.description:
- Specifications:
1. Gate Valve - Air Valve - Butterfly Valve - Ball Valve1 - Control Valve.
2. Setting up a valve manufacturing plant to cater water and wastewater sector requirements across the local and regional markets.

Key products (HS code): 
-Butterfly valve (84818010)
-Gate valves (84818090) 
-Other valves such as air valves, etc.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• The Saudi water sector and NWC represent key demand centers for valves . Valves manufacturing is part of the Saudi Arabian National Industrial Strategy.
• Localization of valve manufacturing aimed at 45% by 2030, up from ~18% in 2021.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Valves market is set to grow at 7% CAGR reaching the size of ~ SAR 11.3 Bn by 2030 driven by O&G, construction, and infrastructure expansion plans. - Planned 1,400+ water distribution projects, worth nearly SAR 124 Bn and SAR 11 Bn worth of investments in wastewater reuse expected from National Water Company (2021 – 26). - 3500+ km of additional water transmission lines expected to be added by The Water Transmission and Technologies Company. - MEWA allocated SAR 150 Bn for water projects under five-year capital portfolio of environment, water & agriculture systems. - Projects such as NEOM, the Red Sea Project, Qiddiya Entertainment City, King Abdullah Financial District and Amaala to create significant demand.

raw.title: uPVC Door and Window Systems Fabrication

details.description:
Establishing one or more uPVC door and window systems fabrication plants to address the local supply gap of 1.4-2.0M units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of uPVC profiles, glass panes, and accessories to fabricate the final product 
- Automation of large-scale assembly lines to competitively fulfil large orders
- Inclusion of adjacent capabilities to extrude uPVC profiles

cardsData.stat:
SAR 90-110M (USD 24-29.3M)
[For a facility of 100K units per year; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to substitute imports of uPVC doors and windows (~SAR 160M in 2022)
• Abundant availability of uPVC resin in Saudi Arabia from SABIC (through SAPPCO), a key local supplier of uPVC resin with production plants in Riyadh and Dammam
• Large production volumes allowing for automation, resulting in EBITDA margins of ~20% in line with global leaders

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• Consolidated local market with three players holding ~60% share; rest addressed by small players and imports, mostly from China and Turkey
• Key local players
• Wintek SA and Fazah Group have capability to locally extrude uPVC profiles with European standards, and Creative Windows Co,, which importing uPVC profiles from Germany
• Local suppliers of input material: Wintek (extrusions), Fazah (extrusions), AGC Obeikan (glass), Uniglass (glass), and Guardian Glass (glass)

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative national demand 32M uPVC units for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

raw.title: WPC Doors Fabrication

details.description:
Establishing one or more wood plastic composite (WPC) doors fabrication plants to address the local supply gap of 780,000-1,000,000 units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of components such as door frame, structure, body, and accessories as per the specifications of a certified or in-house system design
- Inclusion of capabilities to produce WPC cabinetry and cladding

cardsData.stat:
SAR 50-70M (USD 13.3-18.7M)
[For a facility of 100K units per year; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to replace imports of WPC products to Saudi Arabia (~SAR 100M in 2022)
• Abundant local availability of plastic resin, one of the key input materials for WPC

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• Growing market, with several developers in Saudi Arabia already adopting WPC doors as a substitute for wood doors in residential projects (e.g., RAFAL, Almajdiah Residence, Sahel Real Estate Co.)
• Only 2 local producers in Saudi Arabia: Alfadoors and Ablaze
• Local suppliers of input material: Plastic resin from players such as SABIC, Saudi Industrial Resins

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative national demand of 18M units of WPC doors for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

raw.title: Thermal Barrier Strips Production

details.description:
- Establishing one or more production plants for thermal barrier strips to address the local supply gap of 78-100M meters per annum
- Manufacturing thermal barrier strips by molding polyamide 6.6 and glass fiber to meet a significant portion of the anticipated local demand for aluminum windows (~95M aluminum units expected from 2025 to 2040)

cardsData.stat:
SAR 100-120M (USD 26.7-32M)
[For a facility of 20-30M meters per year; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to replace imports of thermal barrier strips (~SAR 70M in 2022)
• Export potential to neighboring countries due to lack of regional production
• Glass fiber and polyamide 6.6 locally available in Saudi Arabia
• Local procurement preference in contracts (e.g., price preference, local content consideration in commercial evaluation)
• Current Market
• Market fully supplied through imports
• Key global players include Technoform (Germany) and Dowell (Australia)
• Local suppliers of input materials: SABIC (polyamide 6.6), NOV (glass fiber), and FRP Technology (glass fiber)

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Increasing regulatory requirements toward lowering the u-value (window’s’ insulation measure) - Demand driven by higher standards for energy efficiency and by large aluminum window orders from PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

raw.title: Fixed Fire Detector Systems Assembly

details.description:
Establishing one or more fixed fire detector systems assembly plants to address the local supply gap of 6-8M units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of heat, smoke, and gas detector systems for commercial and residential applications
- Potential to produce some components in-factory (e.g., external body, electrical wiring)

cardsData.stat:
SAR 20 - 30M (USD 5.3-8M)
[For a facility of 200K units per year; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to replace imports of fixed fire detector systems (~SAR 215M in 2022)
• Local demand for fire detector systems is currently supplied solely through imports; potential first-mover advantage
• Local availability of raw materials for production of external body, electrical wiring
• Export potential to cater to annual demand of over 1M units per annum (~SAR 400M) in rest of GCC (excluding Saudi Arabia)

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• Market for fixed detector systems is supplied through imports mainly from US and Europe
• There is no production facility in Saudi Arabia, or in the GCC region
• Local suppliers of input components
• Ma’aden (aluminum and copper), SABIC (plastic resin)

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative national demand of ~114M units of fixed detector systems for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

raw.title: Epoxy Flooring Coatings Production

details.description:
Establishing one or more epoxy flooring coatings production plants to address the local supply gap of 80,000-86,000 tons per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Focus on residential and commercial segments, but have capability to also supply to the industrial segment
- Inclusion of a wide portfolio of visually appealing designs to drive customer adoption

cardsData.stat:
SAR 30-40M (USD 8-10.7M)
[For a facility of 20 ktpa capacity; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to replace imports of epoxy coatings to Saudi Arabia (SAR 215M in 2022)
• Abundant local availability of key raw materials such as propylene and bisphenol A
• Opportunity to export to the wider GCC region, given limited regional manufacturers and high dependence on imports

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• Epoxy coatings are primarily used in industrial floorings in Saudi Arabia; there are no local producers of epoxy coatings for the residential and commercial segment
• JANA is the only local producer, currently supplying to the industrial segment only
• Local suppliers of input material: Raw materials such as propylene and bisphenol A are available from suppliers such as SABIC, Saudi Kayan

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative national demand ~1M tons of epoxy floor coatings for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

raw.title: Door Locks Production

details.description:
Establishing one or more door locks manufacturing plants to address the local supply gap of 6.3-8.2M locks per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Focus on production of locks for residential doors – both new doors and after sales/ replacement market; large upcoming local demand for residential doors (~98M units from 2025 to 2040)
- Inclusion of capability to produce the sub-components within the facility (e.g., cylinders, bolts, springs)

cardsData.stat:
SAR 30-60M (USD 8-16M)
[For a facility of 1-2M units per year; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to replace imports of door locks (~SAR 400M in 2022)
• Export potential to cater to a market demand of more thn SAR 600M (10-12M units) in GCC (excluding Saudi Arabia)
• Cost competitiveness of local production due to lower logistics cost and avoidance of 15% import tariffs
• Local procurement preference in contracts (e.g., price preference, local content consideration in commercial evaluation)

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• Market supplied solely through imports, of which 47% comes from China, 36% from Europe (Italy 22%, Germany 7%, Spain 6%, Greece 2%), and 5% from the US
• International players
• AssaAbloy ,Yale, and Schlage
• Demand centers
• 50% of demand is driven by contractors requiring premium and medium-grade locks based on the project specification, and 50% from consumer after-sales market for medium-grade locks

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia demand for door locks driven by a cumulative national demand of ~98M residential door units for the 2025-2040 period from PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

raw.title: Concrete Formwork Systems Manufacturing

details.description:
Establishing one or more concrete formwork systems manufacturing plants to address the local supply gap of 2.5-3.5M tons per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Production of steel-based high-specification concrete formwork systems (e.g., for high-rises, bridges, tunnels)
- Inclusion of capabilities to supervise and certify full formwork system assembly on-site

cardsData.stat:
SAR 110-130M (USD 29.3-34.7M)
[For a facility of 100 ktpa capacity; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to replace imports covering >80% of demand of medium- to high spec formwork products
• Local availability of steel raw materials, contributing 70-80% of material cost
• 40-60% reduction in logistics and transportation costs to serve customers in Saudi Arabia, leading to 1-2% reduction in overall operating costs
• Local procurement preference in contracts (e.g., price preference, local content consideration in commercial evaluation)

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• Local players serve low- and some medium-spec segments; global players serve the majority of medium- to high-spec segment
• Players
• Local: Saudi Scaffolding Company, Al Sandan, United Steel, Manar Al Omran, and Attieh-Ulma (JV between ULMA [Spain] and Attieh Group [local])
• Global: include Doka (Austria), PERI (Germany), RMD Kwikform (UAE), Acrow (Turkey), TECON (China)
• Local suppliers of input materials
• Zamil, Al Rajhi, Al Ittefaq, Bahra for steel

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative demand of SAR 52M tons for medium- to high-spec formwork systems in Saudi Arabia for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia
